-- Fitly web platform tables, Drive credential custody, and shared quota ledger.
--
-- Local migration only. Review and apply with `supabase db push` when ready.
-- The existing mobile tables and function request remain backward compatible.

create extension if not exists supabase_vault with schema vault;

create type public.client_platform as enum ('mobile', 'web');
create type public.source_availability_status as enum ('available', 'missing');
create type public.drive_connection_status as enum (
  'connected',
  'reauthorization_required',
  'revoked'
);
create type public.delivery_status as enum ('pending', 'delivering', 'delivered', 'failed');
create type public.generation_attempt_status as enum ('reserved', 'consumed', 'released');
create type public.generation_input_kind as enum ('body_template', 'garment');

alter table public.users alter column template_limit set default 5;
update public.users set template_limit = 5 where template_limit < 5;

create table public.user_consents (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  terms_version text not null check (length(btrim(terms_version)) > 0),
  privacy_version text not null check (length(btrim(privacy_version)) > 0),
  ai_processing_version text not null check (length(btrim(ai_processing_version)) > 0),
  accepted_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index user_consents_current_idx
  on public.user_consents (user_id, accepted_at desc);

create table public.google_drive_connections (
  user_id uuid primary key references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  provider_subject text not null,
  drive_email text not null,
  refresh_secret_id uuid not null,
  root_folder_id text not null,
  body_templates_folder_id text not null,
  garments_folder_id text not null,
  generated_looks_folder_id text not null,
  status public.drive_connection_status not null default 'connected',
  connected_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.web_body_templates (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  client_platform public.client_platform not null default 'web'
    check (client_platform = 'web'),
  name text not null check (length(btrim(name)) > 0),
  pose public.body_pose not null,
  drive_file_id text not null,
  mime_type text not null check (mime_type in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')),
  byte_size bigint not null check (byte_size > 0 and byte_size <= 7340032),
  availability_status public.source_availability_status not null default 'available',
  is_primary boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index web_body_templates_user_idx
  on public.web_body_templates (user_id, created_at desc);
create unique index web_body_templates_one_primary_idx
  on public.web_body_templates (user_id) where is_primary;

create table public.web_garments (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  client_platform public.client_platform not null default 'web'
    check (client_platform = 'web'),
  name text not null check (length(btrim(name)) > 0),
  brand text,
  price text,
  category public.garment_category not null,
  source public.garment_source not null check (source in ('upload', 'camera')),
  product_url text,
  drive_file_id text not null,
  mime_type text not null check (mime_type in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')),
  byte_size bigint not null check (byte_size > 0 and byte_size <= 7340032),
  availability_status public.source_availability_status not null default 'available',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index web_garments_user_idx
  on public.web_garments (user_id, created_at desc);
create index web_garments_category_idx
  on public.web_garments (user_id, category, created_at desc);

create table public.web_tryon_results (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  client_platform public.client_platform not null default 'web'
    check (client_platform = 'web'),
  body_template_id uuid references public.web_body_templates (id) on delete set null,
  garment_ids uuid[] not null check (cardinality(garment_ids) = 1),
  generation_status public.generation_status not null default 'queued',
  delivery_status public.delivery_status not null default 'pending',
  drive_file_id text,
  recovery_output_path text
    check (recovery_output_path is null or recovery_output_path like user_id::text || '/web-recovery/%'),
  recovery_expires_at timestamptz,
  body_template_snapshot jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  garment_snapshots jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  verdict text,
  is_favorite boolean not null default false,
  failure_code text,
  failure_reason text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index web_tryon_results_user_idx
  on public.web_tryon_results (user_id, created_at desc);
create index web_tryon_results_active_idx
  on public.web_tryon_results (generation_status, delivery_status)
  where generation_status in ('queued', 'generating') or delivery_status in ('pending', 'delivering');

create table public.web_generation_inputs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  staging_attempt_id uuid not null,
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  result_id uuid references public.web_tryon_results (id) on delete cascade,
  input_kind public.generation_input_kind not null,
  entity_id uuid not null,
  bucket text not null check (bucket in ('body-photos', 'garments')),
  object_path text not null check (object_path like user_id::text || '/web/%'),
  mime_type text not null check (mime_type in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')),
  byte_size bigint not null check (byte_size > 0 and byte_size <= 7340032),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  expires_at timestamptz not null default (now() + interval '30 minutes'),
  unique (staging_attempt_id, input_kind, entity_id),
  unique (bucket, object_path)
);

create index web_generation_inputs_attempt_idx
  on public.web_generation_inputs (user_id, staging_attempt_id);
create index web_generation_inputs_expiry_idx
  on public.web_generation_inputs (expires_at) where result_id is null;

create table public.generation_attempts (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  client_platform public.client_platform not null,
  result_id uuid not null,
  status public.generation_attempt_status not null default 'reserved',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  consumed_at timestamptz,
  released_at timestamptz,
  release_reason text,
  unique (client_platform, result_id)
);

create index generation_attempts_quota_idx
  on public.generation_attempts (user_id, created_at desc)
  where status in ('reserved', 'consumed');

create or replace function public.touch_updated_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''

begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger web_body_templates_touch_updated_at
  before update on public.web_body_templates
  for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at();
create trigger web_garments_touch_updated_at
  before update on public.web_garments
  for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at();
create trigger web_tryon_results_touch_updated_at

create or replace function public.enforce_template_limit()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  allowed integer;
  used integer;
begin
  select coalesce(template_limit, 5) into allowed
  from public.users
  where id = new.user_id
  for update;

  if tg_table_name = 'web_body_templates' then
    select count(*) into used from public.web_body_templates where user_id = new.user_id;
  else
    select count(*) into used from public.body_photos where user_id = new.user_id;
  end if;

  if used >= allowed then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'template_limit_reached';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger web_body_templates_enforce_limit
  before insert on public.web_body_templates
  for each row execute function public.enforce_template_limit();
create trigger body_photos_enforce_limit
  before insert on public.body_photos
  for each row execute function public.enforce_template_limit();

create or replace function public.store_google_drive_connection(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_provider_subject text,
  p_drive_email text,
  p_refresh_token text,
  p_root_folder_id text,
  p_body_templates_folder_id text,
  p_garments_folder_id text,
  p_generated_looks_folder_id text
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  existing_secret uuid;
  next_secret uuid;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'service_role_required';
  end if;

  select refresh_secret_id into existing_secret
  from public.google_drive_connections
  where user_id = p_user_id
  for update;

  if existing_secret is null then
    select vault.create_secret(
      p_refresh_token,
      'fitly-google-refresh-' || p_user_id::text,
      'Google Drive refresh token for Fitly web'
    ) into next_secret;
  else
    perform vault.update_secret(existing_secret, p_refresh_token);
    next_secret := existing_secret;
  end if;

  insert into public.google_drive_connections (
    user_id,
    provider_subject,
    drive_email,
    refresh_secret_id,
    root_folder_id,
    body_templates_folder_id,
    garments_folder_id,
    generated_looks_folder_id,
    status,
    connected_at
  ) values (
    p_user_id,
    p_provider_subject,
    lower(p_drive_email),
    next_secret,
    p_root_folder_id,
    p_body_templates_folder_id,
    p_garments_folder_id,
    p_generated_looks_folder_id,
    'connected',
    now()
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do update set
    provider_subject = excluded.provider_subject,
    drive_email = excluded.drive_email,
    refresh_secret_id = excluded.refresh_secret_id,
    root_folder_id = excluded.root_folder_id,
    body_templates_folder_id = excluded.body_templates_folder_id,
    garments_folder_id = excluded.garments_folder_id,
    generated_looks_folder_id = excluded.generated_looks_folder_id,
    status = 'connected',
    connected_at = now();
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.get_google_drive_credentials(p_user_id uuid)
returns table (
  provider_subject text,
  drive_email text,
  refresh_token text,
  root_folder_id text,
  body_templates_folder_id text,
  garments_folder_id text,
  generated_looks_folder_id text,
  status public.drive_connection_status
)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'service_role_required';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    c.provider_subject,
    c.drive_email,
    s.decrypted_secret,
    c.root_folder_id,
    c.body_templates_folder_id,
    c.garments_folder_id,
    c.generated_looks_folder_id,
    c.status
  from public.google_drive_connections c
  join vault.decrypted_secrets s on s.id = c.refresh_secret_id
  where c.user_id = p_user_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.get_my_drive_connection()
returns table (
  status public.drive_connection_status,
  drive_email text,
  connected_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz
)
language sql
security definer
set search_path = ''
stable
as $$
  select c.status, c.drive_email, c.connected_at, c.updated_at
  from public.google_drive_connections c
  where c.user_id = (select auth.uid());
$$;

create or replace function public.has_current_fitly_consent(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_terms_version text,
  p_privacy_version text,
  p_ai_processing_version text
)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
set search_path = ''
stable
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_consents c
    where c.user_id = p_user_id
      and c.terms_version = p_terms_version
      and c.privacy_version = p_privacy_version
      and c.ai_processing_version = p_ai_processing_version
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.record_fitly_consent(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_terms_version text,
  p_privacy_version text,
  p_ai_processing_version text
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'service_role_required';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.user_consents
    where user_id = p_user_id
      and terms_version = p_terms_version
      and privacy_version = p_privacy_version
      and ai_processing_version = p_ai_processing_version
  ) then
    insert into public.user_consents (
      user_id, terms_version, privacy_version, ai_processing_version
    ) values (
      p_user_id, p_terms_version, p_privacy_version, p_ai_processing_version
    );
  end if;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.admit_fitly_generation(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_client_platform public.client_platform,
  p_body_template_id uuid,
  p_garment_ids uuid[],
  p_staging_attempt_id uuid default null
)
returns table (result_id uuid, attempt_id uuid, daily_limit integer, used_today integer)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  limit_value integer;
  used_value integer;
  new_result_id uuid;
  new_attempt_id uuid;
  template_snapshot jsonb;
  garment_snapshot jsonb;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'service_role_required';
  end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_user_id::text, 918273));
  select coalesce(u.daily_limit, 3) into limit_value
  from public.users u where u.id = p_user_id for update;
  limit_value := coalesce(limit_value, 3);

  select count(*) into used_value
  from public.generation_attempts a
  where a.user_id = p_user_id
    and a.status in ('reserved', 'consumed')
    and a.created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'utc') at time zone 'utc';

  if used_value >= limit_value then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'daily_cap_reached';
  end if;

  if p_client_platform = 'web' then
    if cardinality(p_garment_ids) <> 1 or p_staging_attempt_id is null then
      raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'invalid_web_generation';
    end if;

    select jsonb_build_object('name', t.name, 'pose', t.pose)
      into template_snapshot
    from public.web_body_templates t
    where t.id = p_body_template_id and t.user_id = p_user_id;

    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', g.id,
      'name', g.name,
      'brand', g.brand,
      'category', g.category
    )) into garment_snapshot
    from public.web_garments g
    where g.id = any(p_garment_ids) and g.user_id = p_user_id;

    if template_snapshot is null or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(garment_snapshot, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 1 then
      raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'source_not_found';
    end if;

    insert into public.web_tryon_results (
      user_id,
      body_template_id,
      garment_ids,
      generation_status,
      delivery_status,
      body_template_snapshot,
      garment_snapshots
    ) values (
      p_user_id,
      p_body_template_id,
      p_garment_ids,
      'queued',
      'pending',
      template_snapshot,
      garment_snapshot
    ) returning id into new_result_id;

    update public.web_generation_inputs
      set result_id = new_result_id
    where user_id = p_user_id and staging_attempt_id = p_staging_attempt_id and result_id is null;

    if not found then
      raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'staging_not_found';
    end if;
  else
    insert into public.tryon_results (
      user_id, body_photo_id, garment_ids, status
    ) values (
      p_user_id, p_body_template_id, p_garment_ids, 'queued'
    ) returning id into new_result_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.generation_attempts (
    user_id, client_platform, result_id, status
  ) values (
    p_user_id, p_client_platform, new_result_id, 'reserved'
  ) returning id into new_attempt_id;

  return query select new_result_id, new_attempt_id, limit_value, used_value + 1;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.finish_generation_attempt(
  p_client_platform public.client_platform,
  p_result_id uuid,
  p_outcome public.generation_attempt_status,
  p_release_reason text default null
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' or p_outcome not in ('consumed', 'released') then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'service_role_required';
  end if;

  update public.generation_attempts set
    status = p_outcome,
    consumed_at = case when p_outcome = 'consumed' then now() else consumed_at end,
    released_at = case when p_outcome = 'released' then now() else released_at end,
    release_reason = case when p_outcome = 'released' then p_release_reason else null end
  where client_platform = p_client_platform
    and result_id = p_result_id
    and status = 'reserved';
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.get_my_generation_quota()
returns table (used_today integer, daily_limit integer, resets_at timestamptz)
language sql
security definer
set search_path = ''
stable
as $$
  select
    count(a.id)::integer,
    coalesce(u.daily_limit, 3),
    (date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'utc') + interval '1 day') at time zone 'utc'
  from public.users u
  left join public.generation_attempts a
    on a.user_id = u.id
    and a.status in ('reserved', 'consumed')
    and a.created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'utc') at time zone 'utc'
  where u.id = (select auth.uid())
  group by u.daily_limit;
$$;

grant select on public.user_consents to authenticated;

grant execute on function public.record_fitly_consent(uuid, text, text, text) to service_role;

  assertEquals(parseBody({ bodyTemplateId: 'nope', garmentIds: [ID] }), null)
  assertEquals(parseBody({ bodyTemplateId: ID, garmentIds: [] }), null)
  assertEquals(parseBody({ bodyTemplateId: ID, garmentIds: ['nope'] }), null)
  assertEquals(parseBody({ bodyTemplateId: ID, garmentIds: Array(5).fill(ID) }), null)
  assertEquals(parseBody({ clientPlatform: 'desktop', bodyTemplateId: ID, garmentIds: [ID] }), null)
  assertEquals(parseBody({ clientPlatform: 'web', bodyTemplateId: ID, garmentIds: [ID] }), null)
  assertEquals(
    parseBody({
      clientPlatform: 'web',
      bodyTemplateId: ID,
      garmentIds: [ID, ID],
      stagingAttemptId: ID,
    }),
    null
  )
})

Deno.test('a half-body template cannot wear legs or shoes', () => {
  assertEquals(isCompatible('half', 'top'), true)
  assertEquals(isCompatible('half', 'bottom'), false)
  assertEquals(isCompatible('half', 'dress'), false)
  assertEquals(isCompatible('half', 'shoes'), false)
  assertEquals(isCompatible('full', 'shoes'), true)
  assertEquals(isCompatible('full', 'unknown-category'), false)
})

Deno.test('buildPrompt names the garment', () => {
  assertStringIncludes(buildPrompt([GARMENT]), 'Acme Bomber')
})

Deno.test('buildVerdict names the garment', () => {
  assertStringIncludes(buildVerdict([GARMENT]), 'Acme Bomber')
})

Deno.test('readPredictionOutput pulls the image url', () => {
  assertEquals(
    readPredictionOutput({ status: 'succeeded', output: 'https://replicate.delivery/x.jpg' }),
    'https://replicate.delivery/x.jpg'
  )
  // Some models return an array; take the first.
  assertEquals(
    readPredictionOutput({ status: 'succeeded', output: ['https://replicate.delivery/y.jpg'] }),
    'https://replicate.delivery/y.jpg'
  )
})

Deno.test('readPredictionOutput throws on a failed or empty prediction', () => {
  assertThrows(
    () => readPredictionOutput({ status: 'failed', error: 'NSFW content detected' }),
    Error,
    'NSFW'
  )
  assertThrows(() => readPredictionOutput({ status: 'succeeded', output: null }), Error, 'no image url')
})

```
/**
 * Pure try-on logic, shared by both halves of the flow.
 *
 * `generate-tryon` (admission) uses parseBody + isCompatible.
 * `run-generation` (worker) uses buildPrompt, buildVerdict and the prediction
 * parsing. Nothing here touches the network or Deno.serve, so it is testable on
 * its own — see tryon-logic.test.ts.
 */

export const MAX_GARMENTS = 4

/** Ported from src/shared/types/domain.ts. The client is not a security boundary. */
export const CATEGORY_POSE_RULES: Record<string, readonly string[]> = {
  top: ['full', 'half'],
  outerwear: ['full', 'half'],
  accessory: ['full', 'half'],
  bottom: ['full'],
  dress: ['full'],
  shoes: ['full'],
}

export type MobileRequestBody = {
  clientPlatform: 'mobile'
  bodyTemplateId: string
  garmentIds: string[]
}

export type WebRequestBody = {
  clientPlatform: 'web'
  bodyTemplateId: string
  garmentIds: [string]
  stagingAttemptId: string
}

export type RequestBody = MobileRequestBody | WebRequestBody

export type GarmentRow = {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  /** Staging location while a generation is in flight; null at rest (ADR 004). */
  storage_path: string | null
  category: string
  name: string | null
  brand: string | null
}

const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i

export function parseBody(raw: unknown): RequestBody | null {
  if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) return null
  const { bodyTemplateId, clientPlatform, garmentIds, stagingAttemptId } = raw as Record<
    string,
    unknown
  >
  if (typeof bodyTemplateId !== 'string' || !UUID.test(bodyTemplateId)) return null
  if (!Array.isArray(garmentIds) || garmentIds.length === 0 || garmentIds.length > MAX_GARMENTS) {
    return null
  }
  if (!garmentIds.every((id) => typeof id === 'string' && UUID.test(id))) return null

  if (clientPlatform === undefined || clientPlatform === 'mobile') {
    return { clientPlatform: 'mobile', bodyTemplateId, garmentIds: garmentIds as string[] }
  }

  if (
    clientPlatform !== 'web' ||
    garmentIds.length !== 1 ||
    typeof stagingAttemptId !== 'string' ||
    !UUID.test(stagingAttemptId)
  ) {
    return null
  }

  const garmentId = garmentIds[0]
  if (typeof garmentId !== 'string') return null
  return { clientPlatform: 'web', bodyTemplateId, garmentIds: [garmentId], stagingAttemptId }
}

export function isCompatible(pose: string, category: string): boolean {
  return (CATEGORY_POSE_RULES[category] ?? []).includes(pose)
}

function describe(g: GarmentRow): string {
  return [g.brand, g.name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || g.category
}

export function buildPrompt(garments: GarmentRow[]): string {
  return [
    'Virtual try-on edit.',
    'The first reference image is a photo of a person; the remaining reference images are garments:',
    `${garments.map(describe).join(', ')}.`,
    'Produce one hyperrealistic photograph of the SAME person wearing those garments.',
    'Preserve their face, body proportions, pose, skin tone and the original background exactly.',
    'Only the clothing changes. Match each garment’s fabric, drape, colour and fit realistically.',
  ].join(' ')
}

/**
 * FLUX returns an image and nothing else, so the stylist's line is written here
 * rather than by the model.
 *
 * ponytail: a template, not a second model call. Swap for a text model only if
 * the copy starts feeling canned to real users.
 */
export function buildVerdict(garments: GarmentRow[]): string {
  const names = garments.map(describe)
  const subject = names.length === 1 ? `The ${names[0]}` : `${names.join(' + ')}`
  return `${subject} on your frame — see how it sits.`
}

export type Prediction = {
  id?: string
  status?: string
  output?: unknown
  error?: unknown
  urls?: { get?: string }
}

export const TERMINAL_STATUSES = ['succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled']

/**
 * Reads the generated image URL out of a Replicate prediction.
 * flux-2-pro's output is a single URI string; older/other models return an array,
 * so both are accepted.
 */
export function readPredictionOutput(payload: unknown): string {
  const prediction = (payload ?? {}) as Prediction

  if (prediction.status !== 'succeeded') {
    const detail =
      typeof prediction.error === 'string' ? prediction.error : JSON.stringify(prediction.error)
    throw new Error(`replicate ${prediction.status ?? 'unknown'}: ${detail ?? 'no error given'}`)
  }

  const output = prediction.output
  const url = typeof output === 'string' ? output : Array.isArray(output) ? output[0] : undefined
  if (typeof url !== 'string' || !url.startsWith('https://')) {
    throw new Error('replicate returned no image url')
  }
  return url
}

import type { SupabaseClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2'

type DriveCredentialRow = {
  provider_subject: string
  drive_email: string
  refresh_token: string
  root_folder_id: string
  body_templates_folder_id: string
  garments_folder_id: string
  generated_looks_folder_id: string
  status: 'connected' | 'reauthorization_required' | 'revoked'
}

type TokenResponse = {
  access_token?: unknown
  error?: unknown
}

export async function getDriveCredentials(
  admin: SupabaseClient,
  userId: string
): Promise<DriveCredentialRow> {
  const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('get_google_drive_credentials', { p_user_id: userId })
  const row = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : null
  if (error || !isDriveCredentialRow(row) || row.status !== 'connected') {
    throw new Error('drive_reauthorization_required')
  }
  return row
}

export async function getGoogleAccessToken(
  admin: SupabaseClient,
  userId: string
): Promise<{ accessToken: string; credentials: DriveCredentialRow }> {
  const credentials = await getDriveCredentials(admin, userId)
  const clientId = Deno.env.get('GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID')
  const clientSecret = Deno.env.get('GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET')
  if (!clientId || !clientSecret) throw new Error('google_oauth_not_configured')

  const response = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: clientId,
      client_secret: clientSecret,
      refresh_token: credentials.refresh_token,
      grant_type: 'refresh_token',
    }),
  })
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as TokenResponse | null
  if (!response.ok || typeof payload?.access_token !== 'string') {
    await admin
      .from('google_drive_connections')
      .update({ status: 'reauthorization_required' })
      .eq('user_id', userId)
    throw new Error('drive_reauthorization_required')
  }

  return { accessToken: payload.access_token, credentials }
}

export async function uploadDriveFile(args: {
  accessToken: string
  bytes: Uint8Array
  contentType: string
  fileName: string
  parentId: string
  appProperties: Record<string, string>
}): Promise<string> {
  const boundary = `fitly_${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '')}`
  const metadata = JSON.stringify({
    name: args.fileName,
    parents: [args.parentId],
    appProperties: args.appProperties,
  })
  const prefix = new TextEncoder().encode(
    `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${metadata}\r\n` +
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: ${args.contentType}\r\n\r\n`
  )
  const suffix = new TextEncoder().encode(`\r\n--${boundary}--`)
  const body = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + args.bytes.length + suffix.length)
  body.set(prefix)
  body.set(args.bytes, prefix.length)
  body.set(suffix, prefix.length + args.bytes.length)

  const response = await fetch(
    'https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart&fields=id',
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${args.accessToken}`,
        'Content-Type': `multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`,
      },
      body,
    }
  )
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as { id?: unknown } | null
  if (!response.ok || typeof payload?.id !== 'string') {
    throw new Error(`drive_upload_failed:${response.status}`)
  }
  return payload.id
}

export async function deleteDriveFile(accessToken: string, fileId: string): Promise<void> {
  const response = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
  })
  if (!response.ok && response.status !== 404) {
    throw new Error(`drive_delete_failed:${response.status}`)
  }
}

function isDriveCredentialRow(value: unknown): value is DriveCredentialRow {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false
  const row = value as Record<string, unknown>
  return (
    typeof row.provider_subject === 'string' &&
    typeof row.drive_email === 'string' &&
    typeof row.refresh_token === 'string' &&
    typeof row.root_folder_id === 'string' &&
    typeof row.body_templates_folder_id === 'string' &&
    typeof row.garments_folder_id === 'string' &&
    typeof row.generated_looks_folder_id === 'string' &&
    (row.status === 'connected' ||
      row.status === 'reauthorization_required' ||
      row.status === 'revoked')
  )
}

/**
 * generate-tryon is the authenticated admission boundary for mobile and web.
 * An absent clientPlatform preserves the deployed mobile request contract.
 */

import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2'
import { isCompatible, parseBody, type RequestBody } from '../_shared/tryon-logic.ts'

const HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000
const TERMS_VERSION = '2026-09-06'
const PRIVACY_VERSION = '2026-09-06'
const AI_PROCESSING_VERSION = '2026-09-06'

const CORS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
}

const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { ...CORS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  })

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS })
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return json({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }, 405)

  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')
  if (!authHeader) return json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401)

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!
  const serviceRoleKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!
  const userClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } },
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  })
  const admin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceRoleKey, { auth: { persistSession: false } })

  const { data: userData, error: userError } = await userClient.auth.getUser()
  const user = userData?.user
  if (userError || !user) return json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401)

  const body = parseBody(await req.json().catch(() => null))
  if (!body) return json({ error: 'invalid_request' }, 400)

  const validationError =
    body.clientPlatform === 'web'
      ? await validateWebRequest(userClient, user.id, body)
      : await validateMobileRequest(userClient, user.id, body)
  if (validationError) return json({ error: validationError.code }, validationError.status)

  const { data: admission, error: admissionError } = await admin.rpc('admit_fitly_generation', {
    p_user_id: user.id,
    p_client_platform: body.clientPlatform,
    p_body_template_id: body.bodyTemplateId,
    p_garment_ids: body.garmentIds,
    p_staging_attempt_id: body.clientPlatform === 'web' ? body.stagingAttemptId : null,
  })
  const admitted = Array.isArray(admission) ? admission[0] : null
  if (admissionError || !admitted?.result_id) {
    const code = admissionError?.message?.includes('daily_cap_reached')
      ? 'daily_cap_reached'
      : 'could_not_queue'
    return json({ error: code }, code === 'daily_cap_reached' ? 429 : 500)
  }

  const resultId = admitted.result_id as string
  const handoff = await startWorker(supabaseUrl, serviceRoleKey, resultId, body.clientPlatform)
  if (!handoff) {
    await markHandoffFailed(admin, body, resultId)
    return json({ error: 'could_not_start' }, 503)
  }

  return json(
    {
      resultId,
      status: 'queued',
      positionInQueue: 1,
      etaSeconds: 25,
      usedToday: admitted.used_today,
      dailyLimit: admitted.daily_limit,
    },
    202
  )
})

type ValidationError = { code: string; status: number }

async function validateMobileRequest(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  userId: string,
  body: Extract<RequestBody, { clientPlatform: 'mobile' }>
): Promise<ValidationError | null> {
  const { data: template } = await client
    .from('body_photos')
    .select('id, user_id, pose')
    .eq('id', body.bodyTemplateId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!template || template.user_id !== userId) return { code: 'template_not_found', status: 404 }

  const { data: garments } = await client
    .from('garments')
    .select('id, user_id, category')
    .in('id', body.garmentIds)
  if (
    !garments ||
    garments.length !== body.garmentIds.length ||
    garments.some((garment) => garment.user_id !== userId)
  ) {
    return { code: 'garment_not_found', status: 404 }
  }
  if (garments.some((garment) => !isCompatible(template.pose, garment.category))) {
    return { code: 'incompatible_template', status: 422 }
  }
  return null
}

async function validateWebRequest(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  userId: string,
  body: Extract<RequestBody, { clientPlatform: 'web' }>
): Promise<ValidationError | null> {
  const [{ data: template }, { data: garments }, { data: connection }, { data: consent }] =
    await Promise.all([
      client
        .from('web_body_templates')
        .select('id, user_id, pose, availability_status')
        .eq('id', body.bodyTemplateId)
        .maybeSingle(),
      client
        .from('web_garments')
        .select('id, user_id, category, availability_status')
        .in('id', body.garmentIds),
      client.rpc('get_my_drive_connection'),
      client.rpc('has_current_fitly_consent', {
        p_user_id: userId,
        p_terms_version: TERMS_VERSION,
        p_privacy_version: PRIVACY_VERSION,
        p_ai_processing_version: AI_PROCESSING_VERSION,
      }),
    ])

  if (!template || template.user_id !== userId) return { code: 'template_not_found', status: 404 }
  if (!garments || garments.length !== 1 || garments[0]?.user_id !== userId) {
    return { code: 'garment_not_found', status: 404 }
  }
  if (template.availability_status !== 'available' || garments[0].availability_status !== 'available') {
    return { code: 'source_missing', status: 409 }
  }
  if (!isCompatible(template.pose, garments[0].category)) {
    return { code: 'incompatible_template', status: 422 }
  }
  const connectionRow = Array.isArray(connection) ? connection[0] : null
  if (connectionRow?.status !== 'connected') {
    return { code: 'drive_reauthorization_required', status: 409 }
  }
  if (consent !== true) return { code: 'consent_required', status: 403 }

  const { data: inputs } = await client
    .from('web_generation_inputs')
    .select('input_kind, entity_id, result_id')
    .eq('staging_attempt_id', body.stagingAttemptId)
    .eq('user_id', userId)
  if (
    !inputs ||
    inputs.length !== 2 ||
    inputs.some((input) => input.result_id !== null) ||
    !inputs.some(
      (input) => input.input_kind === 'body_template' && input.entity_id === body.bodyTemplateId
    ) ||
    !inputs.some(
      (input) => input.input_kind === 'garment' && input.entity_id === body.garmentIds[0]
    )
  ) {
    return { code: 'could_not_stage', status: 409 }
  }
  return null
}

async function markHandoffFailed(admin: SupabaseClient, body: RequestBody, resultId: string) {
  if (body.clientPlatform === 'web') {
    await admin
      .from('web_tryon_results')
      .update({
        generation_status: 'failed',
        failure_code: 'could_not_start',
        failure_reason: "We couldn't start that generation.",
      })
      .eq('id', resultId)
    await purgeWebStaging(admin, body.stagingAttemptId)
  } else {
    await admin
      .from('tryon_results')
      .update({
        status: 'failed',
        failure_reason: "We couldn't start that generation.",
        counted_against_quota: false,
      })
      .eq('id', resultId)
  }
  await admin.rpc('finish_generation_attempt', {
    p_client_platform: body.clientPlatform,
    p_result_id: resultId,
    p_outcome: 'released',
    p_release_reason: 'could_not_start',
  })
}

async function purgeWebStaging(admin: SupabaseClient, stagingAttemptId: string) {
  const { data: inputs } = await admin
    .from('web_generation_inputs')
    .select('bucket, object_path')
    .eq('staging_attempt_id', stagingAttemptId)
  for (const input of inputs ?? []) {
    await admin.storage.from(input.bucket).remove([input.object_path])
  }
  await admin.from('web_generation_inputs').delete().eq('staging_attempt_id', stagingAttemptId)
}

async function startWorker(
  supabaseUrl: string,
  serviceRoleKey: string,
  resultId: string,
  clientPlatform: 'mobile' | 'web'
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/run-generation`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceRoleKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_MS),
      body: JSON.stringify({ resultId, clientPlatform }),
    })
    if (!response.ok) {
      console.error('run-generation handoff rejected', response.status)
      return false
    }
    return true
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('run-generation handoff failed', error)
    return false
  }
}

```

      usedToday: admitted.used_today,
      dailyLimit: admitted.daily_limit,
    },
    202
  )
})

type ValidationError = { code: string; status: number }

async function validateMobileRequest(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  userId: string,
  body: Extract<RequestBody, { clientPlatform: 'mobile' }>
): Promise<ValidationError | null> {
  const { data: template } = await client
    .from('body_photos')
    .select('id, user_id, pose')
    .eq('id', body.bodyTemplateId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!template || template.user_id !== userId) return { code: 'template_not_found', status: 404 }

  const { data: garments } = await client
    .from('garments')
    .select('id, user_id, category')
    .in('id', body.garmentIds)
  if (
    !garments ||
    garments.length !== body.garmentIds.length ||
    garments.some((garment) => garment.user_id !== userId)
  ) {
    return { code: 'garment_not_found', status: 404 }
  }
  if (garments.some((garment) => !isCompatible(template.pose, garment.category))) {
    return { code: 'incompatible_template', status: 422 }
  }
  return null
}

async function validateWebRequest(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  admin: SupabaseClient,
  userId: string,
  body: Extract<RequestBody, { clientPlatform: 'web' }>
): Promise<ValidationError | null> {
  const [{ data: template }, { data: garments }, { data: connection }, { data: consent }] =
    await Promise.all([
      client
        .from('web_body_templates')
        .select('id, user_id, pose, availability_status')
        .eq('id', body.bodyTemplateId)
        .maybeSingle(),
      client
        .from('web_garments')
        .select('id, user_id, category, availability_status')
        .in('id', body.garmentIds),
      client.rpc('get_my_drive_connection'),
      client.rpc('has_current_fitly_consent', {
        p_user_id: userId,
        p_terms_version: TERMS_VERSION,
        p_privacy_version: PRIVACY_VERSION,
        p_ai_processing_version: AI_PROCESSING_VERSION,
      }),
    ])

  if (!template || template.user_id !== userId) return { code: 'template_not_found', status: 404 }
  if (!garments || garments.length !== 1 || garments[0]?.user_id !== userId) {
    return { code: 'garment_not_found', status: 404 }
  }
  if (template.availability_status !== 'available' || garments[0].availability_status !== 'available') {
    return { code: 'source_missing', status: 409 }
  }
  if (!isCompatible(template.pose, garments[0].category)) {
    return { code: 'incompatible_template', status: 422 }
  }
  const connectionRow = Array.isArray(connection) ? connection[0] : null
  if (connectionRow?.status !== 'connected') {
    return { code: 'drive_reauthorization_required', status: 409 }
  }
  if (consent !== true) return { code: 'consent_required', status: 403 }

  const { data: inputs } = await admin
    .from('web_generation_inputs')
    .select('input_kind, entity_id, result_id')
    .eq('staging_attempt_id', body.stagingAttemptId)
    .eq('user_id', userId)
  if (
    !inputs ||
    inputs.length !== 2 ||
    inputs.some((input) => input.result_id !== null) ||
    !inputs.some(
      (input) => input.input_kind === 'body_template' && input.entity_id === body.bodyTemplateId
    ) ||
    !inputs.some(
      (input) => input.input_kind === 'garment' && input.entity_id === body.garmentIds[0]
    )
  ) {
    return { code: 'could_not_stage', status: 409 }
  }
  return null
}

async function markHandoffFailed(admin: SupabaseClient, body: RequestBody, resultId: string) {
  if (body.clientPlatform === 'web') {
    await admin
      .from('web_tryon_results')
      .update({
        generation_status: 'failed',
        failure_code: 'could_not_start',
        failure_reason: "We couldn't start that generation.",
      })
      .eq('id', resultId)
    await purgeWebStaging(admin, body.stagingAttemptId)
  } else {
    await admin
      .from('tryon_results')
      .update({
        status: 'failed',
        failure_reason: "We couldn't start that generation.",
        counted_against_quota: false,
      })
      .eq('id', resultId)
  }
  await admin.rpc('finish_generation_attempt', {
    p_client_platform: body.clientPlatform,
    p_result_id: resultId,
    p_outcome: 'released',
    p_release_reason: 'could_not_start',
  })
}

async function purgeWebStaging(admin: SupabaseClient, stagingAttemptId: string) {
  const { data: inputs } = await admin
    .from('web_generation_inputs')
    .select('bucket, object_path')
    .eq('staging_attempt_id', stagingAttemptId)
  for (const input of inputs ?? []) {
    await admin.storage.from(input.bucket).remove([input.object_path])
  }
  await admin.from('web_generation_inputs').delete().eq('staging_attempt_id', stagingAttemptId)
}

async function startWorker(
  supabaseUrl: string,
  serviceRoleKey: string,
  resultId: string,
  clientPlatform: 'mobile' | 'web'
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/run-generation`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceRoleKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_MS),
      body: JSON.stringify({ resultId, clientPlatform }),
    })
    if (!response.ok) {
      console.error('run-generation handoff rejected', response.status)
      return false
    }
    return true
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('run-generation handoff failed', error)
    return false
  }
}

/** Internal generation worker. The browser must never call this endpoint. */

import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2'
import { encodeBase64 } from 'jsr:@std/encoding@1/base64'
import { getGoogleAccessToken, uploadDriveFile } from '../_shared/google-drive.ts'
import {
  buildPrompt,
  buildVerdict,
  readPredictionOutput,
  TERMINAL_STATUSES,
  type GarmentRow,
  type Prediction,
} from '../_shared/tryon-logic.ts'

const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 7 * 1024 * 1024
const GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000
const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 2_000
const RECOVERY_TTL_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
const REPLICATE_MODEL = Deno.env.get('REPLICATE_MODEL') ?? 'black-forest-labs/flux-2-pro'
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i

const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } })

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return json({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }, 405)

  const serviceRoleKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!
  const bearer = req.headers.get('Authorization')?.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '') ?? ''
  if (!timingSafeEqual(bearer, serviceRoleKey)) return json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401)

  const raw = (await req.json().catch(() => null)) as Record<string, unknown> | null
  const resultId = raw?.resultId
  const clientPlatform = raw?.clientPlatform ?? 'mobile'
  if (
    typeof resultId !== 'string' ||
    !UUID.test(resultId) ||
    (clientPlatform !== 'mobile' && clientPlatform !== 'web')
  ) {
    return json({ error: 'invalid_request' }, 400)
  }

  const admin = createClient(Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!, serviceRoleKey, {
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  })

  if (clientPlatform === 'web') {
    const result = await claimWebResult(admin, resultId)
    if (result.kind === 'missing') return json({ error: 'result_not_found' }, 404)
    if (result.kind === 'finished') return json({ resultId, status: result.status }, 200)
    if (result.kind === 'active') return json({ resultId, status: 'generating' }, 202)

    EdgeRuntime.waitUntil(generateWeb(admin, result.row).catch((error) => {
      console.error('web generation crashed', resultId, safeError(error))
    }))
    return json({ resultId, status: 'generating' }, 202)
  }

  const result = await claimMobileResult(admin, resultId)
  if (result.kind === 'missing') return json({ error: 'result_not_found' }, 404)
  if (result.kind === 'finished') return json({ resultId, status: result.status }, 200)
  if (result.kind === 'active') return json({ resultId, status: 'generating' }, 202)

  const { row, template, garments } = result
  EdgeRuntime.waitUntil(
    generateMobile(admin, row.id, row.user_id, template, garments)
      .catch(async (error) => {
        console.error('mobile generation failed', row.id, safeError(error))
        await failMobile(admin, row.id, "The image didn't come through right.")
      })
      .finally(() => purgeMobileSources(admin, template, garments))
  )
  return json({ resultId, status: 'generating' }, 202)
})

type MobileResult = {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  body_photo_id: string
  garment_ids: string[]
  status: string
}

type Template = {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  storage_path: string | null
  pose: string
}

type WebResult = {
  id: string
  user_id: string
  body_template_id: string | null
  garment_ids: string[]
  generation_status: string
  delivery_status: string
  garment_snapshots: unknown
}

type WebInput = {
  bucket: string
  object_path: string
  input_kind: 'body_template' | 'garment'
  entity_id: string
}

type Claim<T> =
  | { kind: 'missing' }
  | { kind: 'finished'; status: string }
  | { kind: 'active' }
  | { kind: 'claimed'; row: T }

async function claimWebResult(admin: SupabaseClient, resultId: string): Promise<Claim<WebResult>> {
  const { data: current } = await admin
    .from('web_tryon_results')
    .select('id, user_id, body_template_id, garment_ids, generation_status, delivery_status, garment_snapshots')
    .eq('id', resultId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!current) return { kind: 'missing' }
  if (current.generation_status === 'completed' || current.generation_status === 'failed') {
    return { kind: 'finished', status: current.generation_status }
  }
  if (current.generation_status === 'generating') return { kind: 'active' }

  const { data: claimed } = await admin
    .from('web_tryon_results')
    .update({ generation_status: 'generating' })
    .eq('id', resultId)
    .eq('generation_status', 'queued')
    .select('id, user_id, body_template_id, garment_ids, generation_status, delivery_status, garment_snapshots')
    .maybeSingle()
  return claimed ? { kind: 'claimed', row: claimed } : { kind: 'active' }
}

async function claimMobileResult(admin: SupabaseClient, resultId: string) {
  const { data: current } = await admin
    .from('tryon_results')
    .select('id, user_id, body_photo_id, garment_ids, status')
    .eq('id', resultId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!current) return { kind: 'missing' as const }
  if (current.status === 'completed' || current.status === 'failed') {
    return { kind: 'finished' as const, status: current.status }
  }
  if (current.status === 'generating') return { kind: 'active' as const }

  const { data: claimed } = await admin
    .from('tryon_results')
    .update({ status: 'generating' })
    .eq('id', resultId)
    .eq('status', 'queued')
    .select('id, user_id, body_photo_id, garment_ids, status')
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!claimed) return { kind: 'active' as const }

  const [{ data: template }, { data: garments }] = await Promise.all([
    admin
      .from('body_photos')
      .select('id, user_id, storage_path, pose')
      .eq('id', claimed.body_photo_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    admin
      .from('garments')
      .select('id, user_id, storage_path, category, name, brand')
      .in('id', claimed.garment_ids),
  ])
  const ownershipHolds =
    template?.user_id === claimed.user_id &&
    Boolean(template.storage_path) &&
    garments?.length === claimed.garment_ids.length &&
    garments.every((garment) => garment.user_id === claimed.user_id && Boolean(garment.storage_path))
  if (!template || !garments || !ownershipHolds) {
    await failMobile(admin, resultId, "We couldn't find the photos for that look.")
    return { kind: 'finished' as const, status: 'failed' }
  }
  return {
    kind: 'claimed' as const,
    row: claimed as MobileResult,
    template: template as Template,
    garments: garments as GarmentRow[],
  }
}

async function generateMobile(
  admin: SupabaseClient,
  resultId: string,
  userId: string,
  template: Template,
  garments: GarmentRow[]
) {
  const bodyPath = template.storage_path
  const garmentPaths = garments.map((garment) => garment.storage_path)
  if (!bodyPath || garmentPaths.some((path) => !path)) throw new Error('sources_unavailable')

  const bodyImage = await downloadStagedImage(admin, 'body-photos', bodyPath, userId)
  const garmentImages = await Promise.all(
    garmentPaths.map((path) => downloadStagedImage(admin, 'garments', path!, userId))
  )
  const generatedBytes = await fetchGeneratedBytes(await callReplicate(buildPrompt(garments), [bodyImage, ...garmentImages]))
  const outputPath = `${userId}/${resultId}.jpg`
  const { error: uploadError } = await admin.storage
    .from('tryon-results')
    .upload(outputPath, generatedBytes, { contentType: 'image/jpeg', upsert: true })
  if (uploadError) throw uploadError

  const { error: updateError } = await admin
    .from('tryon_results')
    .update({
      status: 'completed',
      output_path: outputPath,
      verdict: buildVerdict(garments),
      match_label: null,
    })
    .eq('id', resultId)
  if (updateError) throw updateError
  await finishAttempt(admin, 'mobile', resultId, 'consumed')
}

async function generateWeb(admin: SupabaseClient, result: WebResult) {
  const { data: inputs } = await admin
    .from('web_generation_inputs')
    .select('bucket, object_path, input_kind, entity_id')
    .eq('result_id', result.id)
  const parsedInputs = (inputs ?? []).filter(isWebInput)

  try {
    const bodyInput = parsedInputs.find((input) => input.input_kind === 'body_template')
    const garmentInput = parsedInputs.find((input) => input.input_kind === 'garment')
    if (!bodyInput || !garmentInput || parsedInputs.length !== 2) throw new Error('sources_unavailable')

    const garments = parseGarmentSnapshots(result.garment_snapshots, result.user_id)
    if (garments.length !== 1) throw new Error('garment_snapshot_invalid')
    const [bodyImage, garmentImage] = await Promise.all([
      downloadStagedImage(admin, bodyInput.bucket, bodyInput.object_path, result.user_id),
      downloadStagedImage(admin, garmentInput.bucket, garmentInput.object_path, result.user_id),
    ])
    const outputUrl = await callReplicate(buildPrompt(garments), [bodyImage, garmentImage])
    const generatedBytes = await fetchGeneratedBytes(outputUrl)

    await finishAttempt(admin, 'web', result.id, 'consumed')
    const { error: completedError } = await admin
      .from('web_tryon_results')
      .update({ generation_status: 'completed', delivery_status: 'delivering' })
      .eq('id', result.id)
    if (completedError) throw completedError

    try {
      const { accessToken, credentials } = await getGoogleAccessToken(admin, result.user_id)
      const driveFileId = await uploadDriveFile({
        accessToken,
        bytes: generatedBytes,
        contentType: 'image/jpeg',
        fileName: `Fitly look ${result.id}.jpg`,
        parentId: credentials.generated_looks_folder_id,
        appProperties: {
          fitlyEntityId: result.id,
          fitlyEntityType: 'look',
          fitlyEnvironment: Deno.env.get('FITLY_ENVIRONMENT') ?? 'production',
        },
      })
      await admin
        .from('web_tryon_results')
        .update({
          delivery_status: 'delivered',
          drive_file_id: driveFileId,
          verdict: buildVerdict(garments),
          failure_code: null,
          failure_reason: null,
        })
        .eq('id', result.id)
    } catch (deliveryError) {
      console.error('web delivery failed', result.id, safeError(deliveryError))
      const recoveryPath = `${result.user_id}/web-recovery/${result.id}.jpg`
      const { error: recoveryError } = await admin.storage
        .from('tryon-results')
        .upload(recoveryPath, generatedBytes, { contentType: 'image/jpeg', upsert: true })
      await admin
        .from('web_tryon_results')
        .update({
          delivery_status: 'failed',
          recovery_output_path: recoveryError ? null : recoveryPath,
          recovery_expires_at: recoveryError
            ? null
            : new Date(Date.now() + RECOVERY_TTL_MS).toISOString(),
          verdict: buildVerdict(garments),
          failure_code: recoveryError ? 'delivery_failed_without_recovery' : 'delivery_failed',
          failure_reason: 'Your look is ready, but we could not save it to Google Drive.',
        })
        .eq('id', result.id)
    }
  } catch (generationError) {
    console.error('web generation failed', result.id, safeError(generationError))
    await admin
      .from('web_tryon_results')
      .update({
        generation_status: 'failed',
        failure_code: 'generation_failed',
        failure_reason: "The image didn't come through right. This try was not counted.",
      })
      .eq('id', result.id)
    await finishAttempt(admin, 'web', result.id, 'released', 'generation_failed')
  } finally {
    await purgeWebInputs(admin, parsedInputs)
  }
}

function parseGarmentSnapshots(value: unknown, userId: string): GarmentRow[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return []
  return value.flatMap((item) => {
    if (typeof item !== 'object' || item === null) return []
    const row = item as Record<string, unknown>
    if (typeof row.id !== 'string' || typeof row.category !== 'string') return []
    return [{
      id: row.id,
      user_id: userId,
      storage_path: null,
      category: row.category,
      name: typeof row.name === 'string' ? row.name : null,
      brand: typeof row.brand === 'string' ? row.brand : null,
    }]
  })
}

function isWebInput(value: unknown): value is WebInput {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false
  const row = value as Record<string, unknown>
  return (
    typeof row.bucket === 'string' &&
    typeof row.object_path === 'string' &&
    typeof row.entity_id === 'string' &&
    (row.input_kind === 'body_template' || row.input_kind === 'garment')
  )
}

async function purgeWebInputs(admin: SupabaseClient, inputs: WebInput[]) {
  for (const input of inputs) {
    await admin.storage.from(input.bucket).remove([input.object_path])
  }
  if (inputs.length > 0) {
    await admin.from('web_generation_inputs').delete().in('object_path', inputs.map((input) => input.object_path))
  }
}

async function purgeMobileSources(admin: SupabaseClient, template: Template, garments: GarmentRow[]) {
  try {
    if (template.storage_path) {
      await admin.storage.from('body-photos').remove([template.storage_path])
      await admin.from('body_photos').update({ storage_path: null }).eq('id', template.id)
    }
    const staged = garments.filter((garment) => garment.storage_path)
    if (staged.length > 0) {
      await admin.storage.from('garments').remove(staged.map((garment) => garment.storage_path!))
      await admin.from('garments').update({ storage_path: null }).in('id', staged.map((garment) => garment.id))
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('could not purge mobile sources', template.id, safeError(error))
  }
}

async function failMobile(admin: SupabaseClient, resultId: string, reason: string) {
  await admin
    .from('tryon_results')
    .update({ status: 'failed', failure_reason: reason, counted_against_quota: false })
    .eq('id', resultId)
  await finishAttempt(admin, 'mobile', resultId, 'released', 'generation_failed')
}

async function finishAttempt(
  admin: SupabaseClient,
  clientPlatform: 'mobile' | 'web',
  resultId: string,
  outcome: 'consumed' | 'released',
  releaseReason: string | null = null
) {
  await admin.rpc('finish_generation_attempt', {
    p_client_platform: clientPlatform,
    p_result_id: resultId,
    p_outcome: outcome,
    p_release_reason: releaseReason,
  })
}

async function downloadStagedImage(
  admin: SupabaseClient,
  bucket: string,
  path: string,
  userId: string
): Promise<string> {
  if (!path.startsWith(`${userId}/`)) throw new Error('path_outside_owner_prefix')
  const { data, error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).download(path)
  if (error || !data) throw error ?? new Error('source_missing')
  if (!data.type.startsWith('image/')) throw new Error('invalid_image')
  if (data.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) throw new Error('image_too_large')
  return `data:${data.type};base64,${encodeBase64(new Uint8Array(await data.arrayBuffer()))}`
}

async function fetchGeneratedBytes(url: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS) })
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`could_not_fetch_output:${response.status}`)
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer())
  if (bytes.length === 0 || bytes.length > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) throw new Error('invalid_generated_image')
  return bytes
}

async function callReplicate(prompt: string, inputImages: string[]): Promise<string> {
  const token = Deno.env.get('REPLICATE_API_TOKEN')
  if (!token) throw new Error('REPLICATE_API_TOKEN is not set')
  const response = await fetch(`https://api.replicate.com/v1/models/${REPLICATE_MODEL}/predictions`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Prefer: 'wait=60',
    },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS),
    body: JSON.stringify({
      input: {
        prompt,
        input_images: inputImages,
        aspect_ratio: 'match_input_image',
        output_format: 'jpg',
        output_quality: 90,
      },
    }),
  })
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`replicate:${response.status}`)

  let prediction = (await response.json()) as Prediction
  const deadline = Date.now() + GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS
  while (!TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(prediction.status ?? '')) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error('replicate_timed_out')
    if (!prediction.urls?.get) throw new Error('replicate_missing_poll_url')
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, POLL_INTERVAL_MS))
    const poll = await fetch(prediction.urls.get, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
    if (!poll.ok) throw new Error(`replicate_poll:${poll.status}`)
    prediction = (await poll.json()) as Prediction
  }
  return readPredictionOutput(prediction)
}

function timingSafeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length === 0 || a.length !== b.length) return false
  let diff = 0
  for (let index = 0; index < a.length; index += 1) {
    diff |= a.charCodeAt(index) ^ b.charCodeAt(index)
  }
  return diff === 0
}

function safeError(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown_error'
}

import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { getPublicEnv } from "@/config/env";

export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });
  const { supabasePublishableKey, supabaseUrl } = getPublicEnv();
  const supabase = createServerClient(supabaseUrl, supabasePublishableKey, {
    cookies: {
      getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
      setAll(cookiesToSet, headersToSet) {
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value));
        response = NextResponse.next({ request });
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, options, value }) => {
          response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
        });
        headersToSet?.forEach(({ name, value }) => response.headers.set(name, value));
      },
    },
  });

  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();
  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;
  const isAppRoute = APP_PREFIXES.some(
    (prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`),
  );
  const isAuthRoute = pathname === "/sign-in" || pathname === "/sign-up";

  if (isAppRoute && !data?.claims) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = "/sign-in";
    url.searchParams.set("next", pathname);
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  if (isAuthRoute && data?.claims) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/looks", request.url));
  }

  return response;
}

const APP_PREFIXES = ["/looks", "/closet", "/try-on", "/me", "/settings"];

import "server-only";

import { getServerEnv } from "@/config/env";

import {
  AI_PROCESSING_VERSION,
  PRE_AUTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS,
  PRIVACY_VERSION,
  TERMS_VERSION,
} from "../auth.constants";

export type PreAuthState = {
  readonly next: string;
  readonly termsVersion: string;
  readonly privacyVersion: string;
  readonly aiProcessingVersion: string;
  readonly expiresAt: number;
};

export async function createPreAuthState(next: string): Promise<string> {
  const state: PreAuthState = {
    next,
    termsVersion: TERMS_VERSION,
    privacyVersion: PRIVACY_VERSION,
    aiProcessingVersion: AI_PROCESSING_VERSION,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + PRE_AUTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS * 1000,
  };
  const payload = toBase64Url(JSON.stringify(state));
  const signature = await sign(payload);
  return `${payload}.${signature}`;
}

export async function readPreAuthState(value: string | undefined): Promise<PreAuthState | null> {
  if (!value) return null;
  const [payload, signature, extra] = value.split(".");
  if (!payload || !signature || extra) return null;
  const expected = await sign(payload);
  if (!timingSafeEqual(signature, expected)) return null;

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(fromBase64Url(payload));
    if (typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null) return null;
    const state = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof state.next !== "string" ||
      !state.next.startsWith("/") ||
      state.next.startsWith("//") ||
      state.termsVersion !== TERMS_VERSION ||
      state.privacyVersion !== PRIVACY_VERSION ||
      state.aiProcessingVersion !== AI_PROCESSING_VERSION ||
      typeof state.expiresAt !== "number" ||
      state.expiresAt < Date.now()
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    return {
      next: state.next,
      termsVersion: state.termsVersion,
      privacyVersion: state.privacyVersion,
      aiProcessingVersion: state.aiProcessingVersion,
      expiresAt: state.expiresAt,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function sign(payload: string) {
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    new TextEncoder().encode(getServerEnv().authStateSecret),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"],
  );
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, new TextEncoder().encode(payload));
  return bytesToBase64Url(new Uint8Array(signature));
}

function timingSafeEqual(left: string, right: string) {
  if (left.length !== right.length) return false;
  let mismatch = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < left.length; index += 1) {
    mismatch |= left.charCodeAt(index) ^ right.charCodeAt(index);
  }
  return mismatch === 0;
}

function toBase64Url(value: string) {
  return bytesToBase64Url(new TextEncoder().encode(value));
}

function bytesToBase64Url(bytes: Uint8Array) {
  return Buffer.from(bytes).toString("base64url");
}

function fromBase64Url(value: string) {
  return Buffer.from(value, "base64url").toString("utf8");
}

import "server-only";

import { z } from "zod";

import { getServerEnv } from "@/config/env";
import { createAdminSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";

import type { DriveCredentials, DriveFolders, DriveIdentity } from "../drive.types";

const DRIVE_API = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3";
const DRIVE_UPLOAD_API = "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3";
const FOLDER_MIME_TYPE = "application/vnd.google-apps.folder";

const userInfoSchema = z.object({
  sub: z.string().min(1),
  email: z.email(),
});

const fileSchema = z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) });
const fileListSchema = z.object({ files: z.array(fileSchema).default([]) });
const tokenSchema = z.object({ access_token: z.string().min(1) });

export async function getGoogleIdentity(accessToken: string): Promise<DriveIdentity> {
  const response = await fetch("https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo", {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("drive_account_lookup_failed");
  const identity = userInfoSchema.parse(await response.json());
  return { subject: identity.sub, email: identity.email.toLowerCase() };
}

export async function ensureDriveFolders(
  accessToken: string,
  environment: string,
  existing?: Partial<DriveFolders>,
): Promise<DriveFolders> {
  const rootFolderId = await ensureFolder({
    accessToken,
    name: "Fitly",
    role: "root",
    environment,
    existingId: existing?.rootFolderId,
  });
  const [bodyTemplatesFolderId, garmentsFolderId, generatedLooksFolderId] =
    await Promise.all([
      ensureFolder({
        accessToken,
        name: "Body Templates",
        role: "body-templates",
        environment,
        parentId: rootFolderId,
        existingId: existing?.bodyTemplatesFolderId,
      }),
      ensureFolder({
        accessToken,
        name: "Garments",
        role: "garments",
        environment,
        parentId: rootFolderId,
        existingId: existing?.garmentsFolderId,
      }),
      ensureFolder({
        accessToken,
        name: "Generated Looks",
        role: "generated-looks",
        environment,
        parentId: rootFolderId,
        existingId: existing?.generatedLooksFolderId,
      }),
    ]);

  return { rootFolderId, bodyTemplatesFolderId, garmentsFolderId, generatedLooksFolderId };
}

export async function storeDriveConnection(args: {
  userId: string;
  identity: DriveIdentity;
  refreshToken: string;
  folders: DriveFolders;
}) {
  const admin = createAdminSupabaseClient();
  const { error } = await admin.rpc("store_google_drive_connection", {
    p_user_id: args.userId,
    p_provider_subject: args.identity.subject,
    p_drive_email: args.identity.email,
    p_refresh_token: args.refreshToken,
    p_root_folder_id: args.folders.rootFolderId,
    p_body_templates_folder_id: args.folders.bodyTemplatesFolderId,
    p_garments_folder_id: args.folders.garmentsFolderId,
    p_generated_looks_folder_id: args.folders.generatedLooksFolderId,
  });
  if (error) throw new Error("drive_connection_store_failed");
}

export async function getDriveAccess(userId: string) {
  const admin = createAdminSupabaseClient();
  const { data, error } = await admin.rpc("get_google_drive_credentials", {
    p_user_id: userId,
  });
  const row = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : null;
  const parsed = driveCredentialsSchema.safeParse(row);
  if (error || !parsed.success || parsed.data.status !== "connected") {
    throw new Error("drive_reauthorization_required");
  }

  try {
    const accessToken = await refreshGoogleAccessToken(parsed.data.refresh_token);
    return { accessToken, credentials: mapCredentials(parsed.data) };
  } catch {
    await admin
      .from("google_drive_connections")
      .update({ status: "reauthorization_required" })
      .eq("user_id", userId);
    throw new Error("drive_reauthorization_required");
  }
}

export async function uploadDriveImage(args: {
  accessToken: string;
  bytes: Buffer;
  contentType: "image/jpeg";
  name: string;
  parentId: string;
  entityId: string;
  entityType: "body-template" | "garment" | "look";
}) {
  const boundary = `fitly_${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "")}`;
  const metadata = JSON.stringify({
    name: args.name,
    parents: [args.parentId],
    appProperties: {
      fitlyEntityId: args.entityId,
      fitlyEntityType: args.entityType,
      fitlyEnvironment: getServerEnv().fitlyEnvironment,
    },
  });
  const body = Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from(
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${metadata}\r\n` +
        `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: ${args.contentType}\r\n\r\n`,
    ),
    args.bytes,
    Buffer.from(`\r\n--${boundary}--`),
  ]);
  const response = await fetch(`${DRIVE_UPLOAD_API}/files?uploadType=multipart&fields=id`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${args.accessToken}`,
      "Content-Type": `multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`,
    },
    body,
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(mapDriveStatus(response.status));
  return fileSchema.parse(await response.json()).id;
}

export async function downloadDriveFile(accessToken: string, fileId: string) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${DRIVE_API}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?alt=media`,
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` }, cache: "no-store" },
  );
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(mapDriveStatus(response.status));
  return {
    bytes: Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()),
    contentType: response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "application/octet-stream",
  };
}

export async function deleteDriveFile(accessToken: string, fileId: string) {
  const response = await fetch(`${DRIVE_API}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}`, {
    method: "DELETE",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok && response.status !== 404) throw new Error(mapDriveStatus(response.status));
}

async function refreshGoogleAccessToken(refreshToken: string) {
  const { googleOAuthClientId, googleOAuthClientSecret } = getServerEnv();
  const response = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: googleOAuthClientId,
      client_secret: googleOAuthClientSecret,
      refresh_token: refreshToken,
      grant_type: "refresh_token",
    }),
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("drive_reauthorization_required");
  return tokenSchema.parse(await response.json()).access_token;
}

async function ensureFolder(args: {
  accessToken: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  environment: string;
  parentId?: string;
  existingId?: string;
}) {
  if (args.existingId && (await folderExists(args.accessToken, args.existingId))) {
    return args.existingId;
  }

  const clauses = [
    `mimeType = '${FOLDER_MIME_TYPE}'`,
    "trashed = false",
    `appProperties has { key='fitlyFolderRole' and value='${args.role}' }`,
    `appProperties has { key='fitlyEnvironment' and value='${args.environment}' }`,
  ];
  if (args.parentId) clauses.push(`'${args.parentId}' in parents`);
  const search = await fetch(
    `${DRIVE_API}/files?q=${encodeURIComponent(clauses.join(" and "))}&fields=files(id)&pageSize=1`,
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${args.accessToken}` }, cache: "no-store" },
  );
  if (!search.ok) throw new Error(mapDriveStatus(search.status));
  const existing = fileListSchema.parse(await search.json()).files[0];
  if (existing) return existing.id;

  const create = await fetch(`${DRIVE_API}/files?fields=id`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${args.accessToken}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      name: args.name,
      mimeType: FOLDER_MIME_TYPE,
      parents: args.parentId ? [args.parentId] : undefined,
      appProperties: {
        fitlyFolderRole: args.role,
        fitlyEnvironment: args.environment,
      },
    }),
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!create.ok) throw new Error(mapDriveStatus(create.status));
  return fileSchema.parse(await create.json()).id;
}

async function folderExists(accessToken: string, folderId: string) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${DRIVE_API}/files/${encodeURIComponent(folderId)}?fields=id,trashed,mimeType`,
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` }, cache: "no-store" },
  );
  if (response.status === 404) return false;
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(mapDriveStatus(response.status));
  const payload = z
    .object({ trashed: z.boolean().default(false), mimeType: z.string() })
    .parse(await response.json());
  return !payload.trashed && payload.mimeType === FOLDER_MIME_TYPE;
}

const driveCredentialsSchema = z.object({
  provider_subject: z.string(),
  drive_email: z.email(),
  refresh_token: z.string(),
  root_folder_id: z.string(),
  body_templates_folder_id: z.string(),
  garments_folder_id: z.string(),
  generated_looks_folder_id: z.string(),
  status: z.enum(["connected", "reauthorization_required", "revoked"]),
});

function mapCredentials(row: z.infer<typeof driveCredentialsSchema>): DriveCredentials {
  return {
    subject: row.provider_subject,
    email: row.drive_email,
    refreshToken: row.refresh_token,
    rootFolderId: row.root_folder_id,
    bodyTemplatesFolderId: row.body_templates_folder_id,
    garmentsFolderId: row.garments_folder_id,
    generatedLooksFolderId: row.generated_looks_folder_id,
    status: row.status,
  };
}

function mapDriveStatus(status: number) {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return "drive_reauthorization_required";
  if (status === 404) return "source_missing";
  return "drive_request_failed";
}

import { cookies } from "next/headers";

import {
  AUTH_CALLBACK_PATH,
  GOOGLE_DRIVE_SCOPE,
  GOOGLE_OAUTH_QUERY_PARAMS,
  POST_SIGN_IN_PATH,
  PRE_AUTH_COOKIE,
  PRE_AUTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS,
} from "@/features/auth/auth.constants";
import { startGoogleAuthSchema } from "@/features/auth/auth.schema";
import { createPreAuthState } from "@/features/auth/services/pre-auth-state.server";
import { createServerSupabaseClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const parsed = startGoogleAuthSchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return Response.json({ error: "consent_required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const origin = new URL(request.url).origin;
  const callbackUrl = new URL(AUTH_CALLBACK_PATH, origin);
  const next = parsed.data.next || POST_SIGN_IN_PATH;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set(PRE_AUTH_COOKIE, await createPreAuthState(next), {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: "lax",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    path: AUTH_CALLBACK_PATH,
    maxAge: PRE_AUTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS,
  });

  const supabase = await createServerSupabaseClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    provider: "google",
    options: {
      redirectTo: callbackUrl.toString(),
      scopes: GOOGLE_DRIVE_SCOPE,
      queryParams: { ...GOOGLE_OAUTH_QUERY_PARAMS },
      skipBrowserRedirect: true,
    },
  });

  if (error || !data.url) {
    cookieStore.delete(PRE_AUTH_COOKIE);
    return Response.json({ error: "oauth_start_failed" }, { status: 502 });
  }

  return Response.json({ url: data.url }, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}
